content_rule: Scenery, cities, nature, harbours and squares are in. Bar, club, nightlife and adult venue cams are out (Anthony, 2026-09-17). The one exception is a stage camera whose feed carries real live music, which Anthony asked for by name the same day; those are gated to the venue's published set times so the app never parks on an empty stage. Cams that only broadcast part of the day or year are kept and given a live_window rather than rejected; see POSE-FORMAT.md.
pose_notes: pose drives the orbit-to-camera dive: lat/lng is the camera's own position, alt_m is eye height above ground, heading is degrees clockwise from north, pitch is degrees below the horizon (negative looks down), fov is vertical field of view.
lat/lng are researched to roughly the right street or beach; heading, pitch and fov are first guesses. aligned:false means nobody has matched the render to the live frame yet.
Press A in the viewer to align the current camera, then S to copy the corrected pose.

poses.format: Every camera carries pose {lat, lng, alt_m, heading, pitch, fov, aligned}, the same shape the earth-dive prototype reads, plus view, confidence and basis added here. heading is a compass bearing in degrees, 0 = north, 90 = east. pitch is degrees from horizontal, negative looking down. fov is the vertical field of view in degrees. alt_m is the eye height the dive lands at, in metres above ground.
poses.view: landscape means the camera sees a real scene with a horizon, so heading and pitch aim the landing at what is actually in frame. topdown means the camera sees a tank, a feeder, a burrow or the inside of the water, with no geographic view to match, so pitch is -89 and the dive ends looking straight down at the spot. heading is still set on those, because it decides which side the dive comes in over.
poses.confidence: high means the mounting point is published or mapped and the heading follows from geometry. medium means the position is solid but the heading is inferred. low means the operator does not publish the spot and the position is site-level or a best guess.
poses.aligned: false on all 47. No pose here has been matched against its live frame yet; that is what the prototype's A key is for.
poses.not_covered: Camera liveness and embeddability are not re-checked here; they carry over from the 2026-09-17 check in this file's check blocks.
poses.corrections: The 74 cameras added by the world thread arrived with provisional poses. Every one was checked against the real terrain model. 25 needed correcting: 12 had alt_m set to the site's elevation above sea level rather than eye height over the ground, 9 were positioned on the subject rather than at the camera, and 4 pointed away from the thing they are named after. Two of those fell in more than one group. All are corrected, each with its own basis line. One camera, the Santo Cristo chapel in Ponta Delgada, went to rejects as a static interior.

rejects.name: Moalboal Live Cam 4K
rejects.reject_reason: Live now, but the owner disabled off-site playback: the embed page returns 'Playback on other websites has been disabled by the video owner'.

rejects.name: VENICE LIVE 24/7 With Piano Music (SkylineWebcams)
rejects.reject_reason: Live, but embedding is disabled by the owner. Same applies in practice to SkylineWebcams' other YouTube streams.

rejects.name: 600 TOP LIVE CAMS from Italy (SkylineWebcams)
rejects.reject_reason: A rotating compilation of hundreds of cams, not one fixed view, so it fights the app's own rotation. Same channel as the stream above whose embedding is disabled.

rejects.name: Rolling Cam Venice / Live Cam around the World
rejects.reject_reason: Rotating multi-cam channels that cut between locations on their own schedule. The app already rotates, and the caption would be wrong half the time.

rejects.name: Ponte delle Guglie, Venice
rejects.reject_reason: Live and popular, but a fourth Venice view. Held out to keep the Italy set varied; its embed was not tested. Promote it if you want more Venice.

rejects.name: Seoul Hangang Live Cam & Lofi Radio (old)
rejects.reject_reason: Dead. The page now reads 'This live stream has been terminated due to use of 3rd party audio or video content.' This id is widely linked from webcam directories, so it is worth keeping in the reject list.

rejects.name: Watchers Club Korea walking streams
rejects.reject_reason: Handheld walking tours, not fixed cameras. The frame moves constantly and the stream stops when the operator goes home.

rejects.name: Seoul Han River lofi (Seoul Vibes)
rejects.reject_reason: Live, but a third view of the same Han River stretch already covered by two kept cams.

rejects.name: Busan Live Cam - Gwangan Bridge (alt)
rejects.reject_reason: Duplicate of the kept Gwangan Bridge cam, from a different channel and with fewer viewers.

rejects.name: South Korea Now (Earth Now)
rejects.reject_reason: Live, but the title names no location and the feed is an aggregator, so there is nothing reliable to caption it with.

rejects.name: El Nido and Boracay (SkylineWebcams site)
rejects.reject_reason: Live and free to watch on Skyline's own page, but there is no embeddable player URL to put in the app: the HLS stream is behind a per-session token and the page offers no iframe embed code. Left out rather than guessed at.

rejects.name: Maria's Living Room and the Agdao shop-interior cams
rejects.reject_reason: Live and embeddable, but they point inside a private living room, a barber shop, a tyre shop and similar. Not scenic, and a rotating desk viewer parking on someone's living room is uncomfortable.

rejects.name: Beluga Boat Underwater Cam
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. The camera hangs off a tour boat that only runs during the summer beluga season in Hudson Bay, and its live flag reads false today.

rejects.name: Meditation Cayman Reef Cam
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. Despite the name it is a recorded meditation loop rather than a camera feed.

rejects.name: Meditation Great White Sharks
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. Recorded highlight reel.

rejects.name: Sharks in the Atlantic
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. Recorded highlight reel.

rejects.name: Channel Islands Kelp Forest, Anacapa
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. explore.org files it under Highlights and its live flag reads false. The underwater camera there runs only during ranger dive programmes, so it cannot carry a rotation slot.

rejects.name: West Coast Sea Nettles jellyfish tank
rejects.reject_reason: Not live, filed under Highlights. The Monterey Bay Aquarium jelly cam in this pack covers the same scene as a real feed.

rejects.name: Blue Spring State Park manatee cams, above and under water
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. Blue Spring is a cold-weather refuge, so these cams run roughly November to March. The Homosassa and Silver Springs cams in this pack cover manatees year round instead.

rejects.name: Strider Rubbing Beach Underwater Orcas
rejects.reject_reason: Not live, filed under Highlights. The OrcaLab underwater feed is mostly a hydrophone with little to look at.

rejects.name: Monterey Bay Aquarium Penguin Cam
rejects.reject_reason: The aquarium's own cam page says 'Currently offline'.

rejects.name: Utopia Village's other five reef cams
rejects.reject_reason: All live, but they are five angles on the same Belize dock and reef wall. One is in the pack; the rest would make the rotation repeat itself.

rejects.name: Decorah Bald Eagles
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. It is absent from explore.org's live roster today, which fits a northern eagle nest sitting empty between breeding seasons.

rejects.name: Brown Bears of Katmai Meditation
rejects.reject_reason: Not live. explore.org lists it in the bear group but it is an edited highlight loop and its live flag reads false.

rejects.name: Brooks Live Chat
rejects.reject_reason: Not a camera. It is a scheduled talk show about the bear cams. Worth naming because its video sits next to the Brooks Falls player in the page markup and is easy to grab by mistake.

rejects.name: Puffin Loafing Ledge
rejects.reject_reason: Live today, but held back. Puffins come ashore only to breed and leave for the open ocean afterwards, so the ledge empties out for most of the year. Fine to add if you want it, just expect bare rock.

rejects.name: Osprey Nest, Charlo Montana
rejects.reject_reason: Live today, but held back for the same reason as the puffins. Ospreys leave on autumn migration and the nest stays empty until spring.

rejects.name: Polar Bears, Cape Churchill and Cape East
rejects.reject_reason: Live today, but held back. The Wapusk tundra cams are pointed at empty snow except during the autumn bear gathering, so they are a narrow seasonal window rather than a standing scene.

rejects.name: Kitten Rescue, Muttville, Service Dog Project and the other rescue cams
rejects.reject_reason: Live and embeddable, but they are indoor shelter rooms, not wildlife. They would make their own pack rather than belong in this one.

rejects.name: Explore.org's own embed path
rejects.reject_reason: Dead end worth recording. The site used to expose a bare player at that path and search engines still index it, but it returns a 404 page now, so the cameras have to be embedded through their YouTube video instead of through explore.org.

rejects.name: Brahma Kumaris (cam from Anthony’s earlier local build)
rejects.reject_reason: Anthony: boring. Not present in this list; recorded so a future merge cannot reintroduce it. Match on name, the original video id is unknown.

rejects.name: Unidentified bar / club stage cam (from Anthony’s earlier local build)
rejects.reject_reason: Anthony: only really live in the evenings when someone is on stage. Standing rule: venue and stage cams are out, scenery/cities/nature/harbours/squares are in. Not present in this list; recorded as a guard for future merges.

rejects.name: Cape Town Weather Cam
rejects.reject_reason: Not continuous: the description says the stream restarts at 03:00 and 15:00 local so each session can be saved as a replay, which fails the 24/7 rule.

rejects.name: Clifton 4th Beach, Cape Town
rejects.reject_reason: Embed blocked: the embed page returns the bare title 'YouTube' with noindex.

rejects.name: Istanbul Hagia Sophia and Bosphorus 4K streams
rejects.reject_reason: Not webcams: pre-recorded travel footage looped around the clock by music channels.

rejects.name: Middle East real-time camera aggregator

rejects.name: Jerusalem crisis coverage (Daystar)

rejects.name: Okaukuejo waterhole, Etosha, and ol Donyo Lodge, Kenya
rejects.reject_reason: Safari lodge waterhole cams of the kind the app already carries. The Namib Desert feed from the same operator was taken instead.

rejects.name: Muizenberg and Strand surf cams
rejects.reject_reason: Surf-report framing, low and narrow on the break rather than a scene to dive into, and session-based rather than continuous.

rejects.name: Valle Nevado pool camera
rejects.reject_reason: Points at the resort swimming pool rather than the mountains. The mountain-facing camera from the same resort was taken instead.

rejects.name: Argentina and Brazil multi-cam channels (Pinamar, Villa Gesell, Earth Now, Cam Nomad)

audio_notes: audio is one of: ambience (the camera's own microphone, expected to be worth hearing), music (the channel carries a music bed, a radio feed or a recitation, so the viewer keeps it silent whatever the speaker button says), unknown (not established either way).
unknown plays when the speaker button is on. Defaulting it to silent would leave most of the list mute and make the button look broken; this way the exceptions are the ones that get silenced.

These tags were assigned from what each channel is, not by listening: the session that wrote them cannot reach youtube.com, so no feed's audio has actually been heard. Shift+M in the viewer silences one camera for good and remembers it, which is how a wrong tag gets fixed.
tag_notes: Every camera carries a `tags` array: place (city, region, country, continent, aliases people type), scene (beach, skyline, waterhole, zoo), and qualities (busy, quiet, night lights, sunset-facing, always-on, has-sound).
Generated by tag.py, which rewrites the array from the camera's own fields plus a hand-written table of what no field knows. Edit tag.py, not this file.
has-sound marks cameras confirmed to carry real ambience or live music. audio: "unknown" means nobody has listened yet, so it gets no tag.
ads_notes: ads is one of: no (an institution, a public body or a non-profit, which do not run advertising on a live feed), yes (a channel whose business is the streams or the broadcast, which does), unknown (not established either way).

The viewer uses this only to order the rotation: an ad-free feed is dealt a little earlier and a monetised one a little later, and nothing is ever dropped for it. What the device has actually seen outranks this field as soon as it has seen anything.

These were assigned from what each channel is, not by watching: no session in this project can reach youtube.com, so no pre-roll has been observed from here. The viewer counts every advert it does meet (roundtrip.adseen on the device) and re-weights that camera itself, which is how a wrong guess corrects.

The only thing that removes advertising rather than ordering around it is a signed-in YouTube Premium account: an embedded player honours the viewer's own subscription. The Ads item in the action strip is that sign-in.
